entities.summary: Johannes Murmellius was a Dutch humanist and teacher who played a significant role in spreading humanism in the Prince-Bishopric of Münster during the Late Medieval period. Born in the early 15th century, Murmellius was a prolific writer and educator who produced numerous textbooks on various subjects, including grammar, rhetoric, and classical literature. His works had a lasting impact on the development of humanism in the region, influencing a generation of scholars and writers. Murmellius's legacy can be seen in the continued emphasis on classical education and the promotion of humanist values in the region. His contributions to the spread of humanism helped shape the intellectual landscape of the region, leaving a lasting impact on the development of Western civilization. As a result, Murmellius is considered one of the key figures in the transmission of classical knowledge and culture during the Late Medieval period.
